statement: Every HTLC time judgment is made in J height: a lock is live through its deadline height; an expiry needs own view > deadline + reserve (reserve >= LAG >= 0); a payee with an unacked resolve reveals on chain at deadline - LAG, and at once on any Account that is quiet: a dispute is open, or the node's signature is out on a settlement or a C2R and nothing is proposed or acked until the chain moves the epoch (R-DISPUTE-FREEZE, R-COSIGN-FREEZE), so no frame can be sealed to ack the resolve. Part (c) is the payee's Runtime duty plus a J-layer fact: clause.ts has no input that says the payee knows the secret or has revealed, so the ts cell holds (a) and (b) and (c) is owed to the Runtime cut.

layers.contract: n/a: the judgments are made off-chain in J height; the chain's own deadline is H1
